behavior.on_fail: BLOCK ingest; ReviewQueue notifies Compliance + Ops.
behavior.non_retroactive_revocation: License validity uses MassID.pickupAt as floor; subsequent revocation doesn't invalidate past records.
behavior.revalidation: On PARTICIPANT_UPDATE (hauler license changes) and DOCUMENT_UPDATE (license re-upload).

edge_cases: LATAM equivalence (Licença Ambiental BR / ENTRE in MX / etc): doc.licensingAuthority field captures issuing body; PG-23 accepts as long as doc type='hauler_license' regardless of authority.
Multi-leg transports (multiple haulers in one MassID via MassIdEvent chain): each hauler validated separately via secondary trigger on MassIdEvent write.
non_retroactive_revocation aligned with ADR-040 + Onda 1-4 principle.
EU-04 remains active for LEGAL_OPERATION gate; PG-23 is independent (not sibling) per ADR-041.
rules.methodology_quote: Resolves D-03 — Big Bang 2026-06-03.

bv_verification.procedure: TBD per ADR-041 Big Bang rollout; BV procedure to be defined alongside Validation Engine implementation.

rules.title: Attached document integrity (hash + timestamp + version)

secondary_triggers.purpose: Detect content drift between hash and stored bytes.

rules.purpose: Resolves D-12 (HIGH reverse_gap): EU-21 requires document integrity hash; PURE only hashes the MassID (P-63), not attached evidence. Without document hash + timestamp + version, replay attacks (same PDF reused) pass silently. PG-24 establishes integrity gate on every evidence attachment: hash (SHA-256) + immutable timestamp + version chain. Independent of EU-21 (transversal — applies to all evidence refs, every participant type).
rules.logic_human: BLOCK if Document is attached without sha256Hash OR uploadedAt OR version field. BLOCK if subsequent content read produces hash != stored sha256Hash (drift detection on DOCUMENT_UPDATE).

messages.block_pt: Documento sem metadados de integridade (hash SHA-256, timestamp ou versão). Re-upload obrigatório.
messages.block_en: Document missing integrity metadata (SHA-256 hash, timestamp, or version). Re-upload required.

behavior.on_fail: BLOCK; incident logged at AuditLog with hash mismatch detail.
behavior.performance: Drift detection: NIGHTLY via sampling (1% rotativo across Documents últimos 30 dias + 100% dos high-value=DocumentType in [RECYCLER_LICENSE, COMPLETION_CERTIFICATE, TOS_ACCEPTANCE, AUDITOR_VALIDATION]) + ON-WRITE trigger via S3 ObjectModified event. Budget: <2h por noite, <$30/mês storage GET cost. Job que exceder budget gera alert pra Compliance ajustar sampling.
behavior.revalidation: On EVIDENCE_ATTACH + nightly drift detection (PERIODIC_JOB).

positive.name: Valid metadata + intact content
positive.given: sha256Hash set, uploadedAt set, version=1, content matches hash.

edge_cases: Document versions: new upload creates new Document row with version=N+1 and new sha256Hash. Old version preserved (audit chain).
Replay attack defense: same PDF uploaded twice gets the same hash but different uploadedAt + different Document.id — PG-24 still validates each independently.
Drift detection runs nightly across all active Documents; on-demand re-check on DOCUMENT_UPDATE.
Storage backend can be S3/GCS/local — abstracted via ctx.storage.sha256(storageRef).
Aligned with EU 2024/1157 Art. 26 + eIDAS 910/2014 (timestamp integrity).

PERF BUDGET: nightly scan full O(filesize) sobre 100k+ Documents seria ~500GB/noite — proibitivo. Substituído por sampling (1% rotativo + 100% high-value DocumentTypes) + S3 ObjectModified trigger pra cobertura real-time. ADR pra detalhar quando volume crescer.

references.section: Transversal mirror — applies to all evidence

rules.methodology_quote: Resolves D-12 — Big Bang 2026-06-03.

bv_verification.procedure: TBD per ADR-041 Big Bang rollout; BV procedure to be defined alongside Validation Engine implementation.

rules.title: Audit trail retention >=5 years (periodic check)
rules.purpose: Resolves D-13 (HIGH reverse_gap): EU-22 mandates 5y audit trail retention; PURE methodology silent. Without explicit retention rule, ops can purge logs prematurely (legal exposure under WSR + GDPR). PG-25 runs periodic job validating oldest record per category meets retention period from docs/config/retention_policy_v1.json. Purge actions allowed only when retention_period_expired AND purge_authorized=TRUE (DPO+Compliance joint sign-off).
rules.logic_human: BLOCK if any retention-protected category has records older than retention_period AND no purge_authorization. PASS if all categories within window or properly purged.

messages.block_pt: Política de retenção violada. Categoria(s) com registros além do prazo legal e sem autorização de purga conjunta DPO+Compliance.
messages.block_en: Retention policy violated. Category(ies) with records past legal retention without joint DPO+Compliance purge authorization.

behavior.on_fail: BLOCK TRC issuance until retention issue resolved; alert DPO + Compliance.
behavior.performance: O(categories) per run; categories are small (7 in retention_policy_v1).
behavior.revalidation: Monthly PERIODIC_RETENTION_CHECK job.

positive.name: All categories within retention
positive.given: All oldest records within 5y window (or younger).

negative.name: Category over retention without purge auth
negative.given: massid_event_log oldest=2020-05-01, retention=5y, ctx.now=2026-06-03, no PurgeAuthorization.

negative.name: Category over retention with valid purge auth
negative.given: Same as above + PurgeAuthorization signed by DPO+Compliance with category='massid_event_log' and retentionExpiresAt<=now.

edge_cases: Periodic job runs first of each month (configurable in scheduler).
Purge authorization is per-category and time-bounded (one auth = one purge window).
Legal hold scenarios (litigation) require separate flag (out of scope for v1; future ADR if needed).
GDPR alignment: personal_data_pii category retention = 5y with explicit lawful basis (legitimate interest + legal obligation under WSR).
Aligned with EU 2024/1157 Art. 26 + GDPR Art. 5(1)(e).

rules.title: Scale calibration certificate (universal sibling of RC-07)

conditions: MassID has weighEvent AND weighEvent.scaleType IN (bridge_scale, floor_scale, hopper_scale)

secondary_triggers.purpose: Re-evaluate when calibration is renewed.

rules.purpose: Resolves D-21 (HIGH reverse_gap): RC-07 validates weighbridge calibration (annual); PURE has no global equivalent. Sibling of RC-07 (ADR-037 + ADR-041): same physical signal (calibration of the scale used to record WeighEvent), declared severities differ intentionally (PG-26 FLAG, RC-07 BLOCK for RecyClass-scoped). Resolver max_among_pillars elevates effective severity to BLOCK when participant is RecyClass-scoped.
rules.logic_human: FLAG if scaleType is industrial (bridge/floor/hopper) AND no valid scale_calibration_certificate within 12 months of weighEvent timestamp. Effective severity becomes BLOCK via sibling RC-07 for RecyClass-scoped participants.

messages.flag_pt: Calibração da balança industrial ausente ou vencida (>12m) na data da pesagem. Verifique anualmente.
messages.flag_en: Industrial scale calibration missing or expired (>12m) at weighEvent date. Renew annually.
messages.block_pt: (via sibling RC-07) Participant RecyClass-scoped: calibração da balança é mandatória.
messages.block_en: (via sibling RC-07) RecyClass-scoped participant: scale calibration is mandatory.

behavior.on_fail: FLAG (BLOCK via sibling resolver for RecyClass-scoped); ReviewQueue surface.
behavior.non_retroactive_revocation: Calibration validity computed at weighedAt, not at evaluation.
behavior.revalidation: On weighEvent write + DOCUMENT_UPDATE (calibration renewal).

edge_cases: Sibling with RC-07: RecyClass-scoped recyclers see effective BLOCK via max_among_pillars resolver (ADR-037).
Artisanal/manual scales SKIP — calibration not required (smallholder ops out of scope).
Scale identity via WeighEvent.scaleId — each scale tracked independently; multi-scale facility cleared individually.
12-month window aligned with RecyClass V1.1 §3.2 + EN ISO 6789 traceability conventions.

rules.title: Recycler pellet loss prevention procedure (universal sibling of RC-13)

secondary_triggers.purpose: Re-evaluate on procedure renewal.

rules.purpose: Resolves D-25 (HIGH reverse_gap): RC-13 validates recycler pellet loss prevention procedure (microplastic discharge prevention); PURE markets it as co-benefit but doesn't gate. Sibling of RC-13 (ADR-037 + ADR-041): same procedure check, declared severities differ (PG-27 FLAG, RC-13 BLOCK for RecyClass-scoped). Resolver max_among_pillars handles RecyClass-scoped escalation. ESG / reputational value: closes inconsistency between PURE marketing (microplastic reduction co-benefit) and absence of operational gate.
rules.logic_human: FLAG if Participant.pelletLossProcedure document missing OR not renewed within last 12 months. Effective BLOCK via sibling RC-13 for RecyClass-scoped.

messages.flag_pt: Recicladora sem procedimento de prevenção de perda de pellet (microplástico) válido. Renove anualmente.
messages.flag_en: Recycler without valid pellet loss prevention procedure (microplastic). Renew annually.
messages.block_pt: (via sibling RC-13) Participant RecyClass-scoped: procedimento de prevenção de pellet loss é mandatório.
messages.block_en: (via sibling RC-13) RecyClass-scoped participant: pellet loss prevention procedure is mandatory.

behavior.on_fail: FLAG; ReviewQueue surface.
behavior.non_retroactive_revocation: Procedure validity computed at MassID.pickupAt for downstream gates.
behavior.revalidation: On PARTICIPANT_UPDATE + DOCUMENT_UPDATE (procedure renewal).

edge_cases: Sibling with RC-13: RecyClass-scoped recyclers see effective BLOCK via resolver.
Document captures procedure narrative + standard reference (e.g., Operation Clean Sweep) + auditor sign-off.
Annual review aligned with OCS / RecyClass V1.1 §4.3 + EU SUP Directive guidance on plastic loss.
ESG dashboard surface: PG-27 status feeds into Sustainability Report.

rules.title: Recycler chemical compliance (REACH / SVHC / POP) — universal sibling of RC-16

secondary_triggers.purpose: Re-evaluate on certificate renewal.

rules.purpose: Resolves D-28 (HIGH reverse_gap): RC-16 enforces REACH/SVHC/POP chemical screening for recycled output; PURE silent. Sibling of RC-16 (ADR-037 + ADR-041): same screening requirement, severities differ (PG-28 FLAG, RC-16 BLOCK for RecyClass-scoped). Reads svhc_substances_v1 config doc for substance classes + thresholds by intendedEndUse (FOOD_CONTACT 0 ppm strict / GENERAL 100 ppm / TECHNICAL self-declaration). Risk: SVHC contamination in food-grade rPET — regulatory + reputational liability.
rules.logic_human: FLAG if RecyclingOutcome.intendedEndUse=FOOD_CONTACT or GENERAL AND no valid svhc_screening_certificate within renewal_months window OR certificate doesn't cover required substance classes per config doc OR certificate shows substance ppm > max_svhc_ppm threshold.

messages.flag_pt: Certificado de triagem SVHC ausente, vencido ou com substâncias acima do limite para intendedEndUse declarado.
messages.flag_en: SVHC screening certificate missing, expired, or with substances above threshold for declared intendedEndUse.
messages.block_pt: (via sibling RC-16) Participant RecyClass-scoped: triagem SVHC é mandatória.
messages.block_en: (via sibling RC-16) RecyClass-scoped participant: SVHC screening is mandatory.

behavior.on_fail: FLAG (BLOCK via sibling resolver for RecyClass-scoped); ReviewQueue surface.
behavior.non_retroactive_revocation: Certificate validity computed at RecyclingOutcome.createdAt.
behavior.revalidation: On RECYCLING_OUTCOME_WRITE + DOCUMENT_UPDATE (certificate renewal).

edge_cases: Sibling with RC-16: RecyClass-scoped recyclers see effective BLOCK via resolver (ADR-037).
Substance classes seeded from ECHA SVHC list + EU POP Annex IV; quarterly Compliance refresh per config doc.
intendedEndUse FOOD_CONTACT requires 0 ppm strict (any detection = FLAG); GENERAL 100 ppm; TECHNICAL self-declaration acceptable.
IMP-66 (Onda 5) introduces intendedEndUse enum — this rule consumes it.
Document.testResults schema: [{substance_id: 'Pb', measured_ppm: 50, LOD: 5}, ...] — referenced by config doc substance_classes_relevant_to_plastic_recycling.
